fusions.name: Shoal Skip
fusions.desc: Hurls the fork, which deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spear the Shallows
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full range. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Channel Stakes
fusions.desc: Drives forked stakes into the ground for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds they spear an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt of water flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 15% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
